metadata.description: Short lowercase prefix used for Azure resource names.

applicationAlertDefinitions.name: media-or-callback-failures
applicationAlertDefinitions.description: Teams media admission, callback authentication, or forced termination failed.
applicationAlertDefinitions.query: AppTraces | where Message has_any ("Teams media start failed", "callback authentication", "forced_termination", "runtime validation is fail-closed") | summarize Breaches=count()

applicationAlertDefinitions.name: dropped-media-frames
applicationAlertDefinitions.description: Teams media frames were dropped during the alert window.

applicationAlertDefinitions.name: realtime-latency
applicationAlertDefinitions.description: Teams media setup or realtime latency exceeded the approved threshold.
applicationAlertDefinitions.query: AppMetrics | where Name in ("teams.media.setup.latency", "teams.call.provider.latency") | summarize Breaches=percentile(Max, 95)

resources.name: [variables('vmssName')]

protectedSettings.commandToExecute: [format('powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy AllSigned -File .\Install-TeamsMediaHost.ps1 -ApiPackagePath .\VirtualCompany.Api.zip -ApiPackageSha256 {0} -KeyVaultName {1} -CertificateSecretName {2} -ConfigurationSecretName {3} -ServiceFqdn {4} -MediaInternalPort {5} -MediaPublicPort {6} -ManagedIdentityClientId {7}', parameters('apiPackageSha256'), parameters('keyVaultName'), parameters('mediaCertificateSecretName'), parameters('teamsConfigurationSecretName'), variables('serviceFqdn'), parameters('mediaInternalPort'), parameters('mediaPublicPort'), reference(resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', variables('identityName')), '2023-01-31').clientId)]

dependsOn: [extensionResourceId(resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', parameters('keyVaultName')), 'Microsoft.Authorization/roleAssignments', guid(resourceId('Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults', parameters('keyVaultName')), resourceId('Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities', variables('identityName')), 'Key Vault Secrets User'))]
